rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule 15's imperative/declarative mood split is defined for exercise vs. lecture files specifically ('Exercise `##` headings = imperative... Lecture headings = claims'). This file is a supplementary reference/progressive-reading page, not an exercise or lecture, so the binary mood contract doesn't bind it the same way; headings here are a mix of topical labels ('Diagrams', 'Skill catalog by phase') and one imperative worksheet heading ('Map your own kit'), consistent with a lookup/reference register rather than a violation of either mood.
